text:
ops_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: increased restarts & OOMs observed in model-serving pool ap-southeast-1 after latest rolling deploy of model-bert-large-v2. Paging oncall.
zara_oncall: seeing 502/503s and quick pod restarts on pool 'dedicated-asia-1'. K8s events show `oom_kill` for process `redwood-serve` on several nodes.
miguel_dev: rolled model-bert-large-v2 at 2026-03-18T02:10:00Z to dedicated pools. Reverting rollout now to previous variant (model-bert-large-v1) on dedicated-asia-1.
emm_sre: adding logs/traces. Sample container log:
```
[2026-03-18T02:22:11Z] runtime: Alloc failed: requested 420MB, only 12MB free -> OOM
[2026-03-18T02:22:11Z] killing process 2345 (redwood-serve)
```
ml_infra: hypothesis: new model's attention cache memory pattern + a GC bug in runtime 1.4.2 causing leaks under medium-concurrency long-context requests. Rolling back runtime to 1.4.1 on canary nodes while we revert model.
prod_comm: status page set: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1769807777 — Impact: intermittent 5xxs for Dedicated in APAC. Mitigation underway.
cs_rep: receiving tickets from 2 dedicated customers reporting degraded service; informing them of rollback and ETA ~30m.
zara_oncall: rollback to model-bert-large-v1 initiated across 6/6 nodes in dedicated-asia-1. Restarts stopped and OOMs no longer appearing on canaries. 5xx rate trending down.
miguel_dev: confirmed: after revert, memory stable. Will coordinate with ML Infra for root cause repro and fix.
ml_infra: next steps: 1) reproduce memory leak locally with stress tests, 2) run runtime 1.4.2 memory profiler, 3) hold model-bert-large-v2 from global rollout until patch.
prod_comm: updated status: "Mitigation: model revert complete; monitoring for 60m. Postmortem and customer advisory to follow."
emm_sre: postmortem owner: emm_sre. Action items assigned: add OOM alert per-pool, add canary runtime check before model rollout, add per-request memory caps.
cs_rep: sent interim customer notice and offered mitigation support. No data loss reported.
ops_bot: RESOLVED signal at 1769809600 — service metrics returned to baseline, incident closed. Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/pm/1769807777-postmortem
